note: Official sources only (county/city election offices and state election officials). null = not found in an official source. All times local to the jurisdiction. openOnOct30 = whether an eligible unregistered person can still register AND vote in this election on Fri Oct 30, 2026.

earlyVoting.hours: 7:00 AM-7:00 PM daily (Monday-Sunday), Oct 19-30; select sites extended to 7:00 AM-10:00 PM on Thu Oct 29 and Fri Oct 30

dailyHours.appliesTo: extended-hours sites only (marked * on the county list): Ben Hur Shrine Center, Lakeway Activity Center, Millennium Youth Entertainment Complex, PfISD Rock Gym, Randalls Brodie, Travis County Clerk (5501 Airport Blvd), UT Texas Union
TCC Complex (3614 Bill Price Rd, Del Valle) is an early voting site on Fri Oct 30 only

earlyVoting.anySiteNote: You may vote at any polling site in Travis County.
earlyVoting.mainLocation: Travis County Clerk's Office, 5501 Airport Blvd, Austin, TX 78751
locationsIn78701: Austin City Hall, Media Room 1034, 301 W 2nd St
Austin Recreation Center, Dance Studio, 1301 Shoal Creek Blvd
Travis County Civil and Family Courts Facility, Conference Room, 1700 Guadalupe St

registration.notes: Texas has no same-day registration; the Oct 5 deadline has passed. A voter who moved from another Texas county and is still registered there may be eligible for a 'limited ballot', available only during early voting (through Oct 30) at 5501 Airport Blvd; call (512) 238-8683 to confirm eligibility.

mail.eligibility: Texas ballot by mail is limited to eligible voters (e.g., 65+, disabled, absent from the county, etc.).
mail.requestDeadlineRule: Application must be received (not postmarked) by close of business or 12 noon, whichever is later, on Fri Oct 23, 2026.
mail.returnRule: Postmark + receipt: USPS ballots must be postmarked by 7:00 PM on Election Day (Nov 3) and received by 5:00 PM on the next business day (Wed Nov 4, 2026). If no postmark, must be received by 7:00 PM Nov 3. Common/contract carrier: received by 7:00 PM Nov 3 (or by 5:00 PM next day if carrier receipt mark shows before 7:00 PM Nov 3). In-person hand delivery by the voter only, with ID, at 5501 Airport Blvd on Election Day only, 7:00 AM-7:00 PM.

94103.name: City and County of San Francisco, CA

earlyVoting.hours: Weekdays 8:00 AM-5:00 PM (closed Mon Oct 12 holiday); weekends Oct 24-25 and Oct 31-Nov 1 10:00 AM-4:00 PM; Election Day 7:00 AM-8:00 PM

dailyHours.appliesTo: City Hall Voting Center (weekend entry via Grove Street)
City Hall Voting Center and all 501 polling places

earlyVoting.mainLocation: City Hall Voting Center, ground floor of City Hall in front of Room 48, 1 Dr. Carlton B. Goodlett Place, San Francisco, CA 94102
earlyVoting.otherLocations: Only the City Hall Voting Center is listed for in-person voting before Election Day. 37 official ballot drop boxes in SF from Oct 5 through Election Day.

registration.deadlineMeaning: Regular deadline (15 days before) to register and be mailed a ballot
registration.notes: Same-day (conditional) voter registration: eligible residents can still register and vote in person at the City Hall Voting Center through Nov 3 (Fri Oct 30 hours: 8:00 AM-5:00 PM) or at any SF polling place on Election Day. Ballots are counted once the county verifies the registration. Eligible non-citizen residents can also register and vote in the Board of Education contest only.

mail.eligibility: Every registered California voter is mailed a ballot (mailed to SF voters in early October).
mail.requestDeadlineRule: No application needed. Replacement ballot requests: contact the Department or use the Voter Portal at least 7 days before Election Day (by Tue Oct 27, 2026); after that, vote in person.
mail.returnRule: Postmark + receipt: mailed ballots must be postmarked on or before Nov 3 and received no later than 7 days after Election Day (Tue Nov 10, 2026). Or drop off at any California drop box, polling place, vote center, or county elections office by 8:00 PM Nov 3. Postage-paid envelope.

electionDay.anySiteNote: 501 polling places; voters have an assigned polling place (back cover of Voter Information Pamphlet / Voter Portal). Same-day registrants can register and vote at any SF polling place.

10001.name: New York County (Manhattan), New York City, NY

earlyVoting.anySiteNote: NYC voters are assigned an early voting site, which may differ from their Election Day poll site. Look it up by address.
earlyVoting.mainLocation: Manhattan borough office (mail ballot applications/drop-off, not an early voting site): 200 Varick Street, 10th Fl, New York, NY 10014

registration.notes: Applications (in person or by mail) must be received by the board of elections by Sat Oct 24, 2026 (10 days before). No same-day registration found in official sources. Deadline has passed.

mail.eligibility: Any registered voter may request an early mail ballot (no excuse); absentee ballots are for voters with a stated reason.
mail.requestDeadlineRule: Online portal or mail applications must be received by Sat Oct 24, 2026 (passed). In-person applications at the county board of elections through Mon Nov 2, 2026. Manhattan office: 200 Varick St, 10th Fl; extended hours Fri Oct 30 10:00 AM-4:00 PM, Sat Oct 31 9:00 AM-4:00 PM, Sun Nov 1 10:00 AM-4:00 PM, Mon Nov 2 9:00 AM-5:00 PM (regular weekday hours).
mail.returnRule: Postmark + receipt: postmarked no later than Nov 3 and received by the county BOE by Tue Nov 10, 2026. Or drop off at the county BOE office by 9:00 PM Nov 3, any early voting site in the county Oct 24-Nov 1, or any Election Day poll site in the county by 9:00 PM Nov 3. Postage included.
